label: Authentic Jobs
docs_url: https://authenticjobs.com/ (RSS feed linked in the footer)
terms_note: Public RSS; apply via the posting's external link / e-mail; terms not read.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (WordPress RSS). Lane `assist` → **keep**; feed usable for discovery. Confidence high.
reference.limits: - Public RSS; robots.txt disallows /feed/ (jobs-tab audit) — use the query form. - Public RSS; apply via the posting's external link / e-mail; terms not read.

adapter.rate_note: No rate limit is published for the REST API; robots.txt asks for 'Crawl-delay: 3', so one request every three seconds.
adapter.terms: Listings are Authentic Jobs content; apply through each listing's own link. robots.txt (Disallow: /*?, Crawl-delay: 3) is aimed at crawlers — keep usage to on-demand lookups at the crawl-delay pace.

search_postings.note: GET /wp-json/wp/v2/job-listings: the WP Job Manager 'job_listing' post type exposed through the WordPress REST API posts controller (arguments page, per_page ≤ 100, search, and the job-categories / job-types taxonomy filters, as listed by the route's own schema at https://authenticjobs.com/wp-json/wp/v2/job-listings (OPTIONS)). `query` is WordPress full-text `search`; `category` is a job-categories TERM ID (GET /wp-json/wp/v2/job-categories lists them) — not a slug. min_budget is not sent (salary is free text in meta._job_salary). title/description are rendered HTML; buyer is meta._company_name, deadline meta._job_expires (often absent); the apply link (meta._application) and location stay in raw.meta. Only published, public listings are returned.

get_posting.note: GET /wp-json/wp/v2/job-listings/<id> (the numeric post id from search_postings). An unknown id answers 404 rest_post_invalid_id.

not_offered.me: Anonymous read-only REST access; there is no account to verify without a WordPress login, which the board does not offer to API clients.
not_offered.submit_bid: No application endpoint: each listing carries an external apply URL or e-mail (meta._application); candidates apply there.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging in the REST routes (posts, taxonomies and media only).
not_offered.send_message: No messaging in the REST routes (posts, taxonomies and media only).
not_offered.credits: Free to read; no account, credit or balance endpoint.

live_check.notes: a transient 503 on page 2 in the first pass; clean on rerun; all read tools answered, schema-valid, pagination advances
